# which

Locate executable commands on PATH through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/which moon

moonx cli/which -a moon
```

Search PATH or inspect an explicit path. Windows also uses PATHEXT.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-a`, `--all` | Print every match instead of the first. |
| `-s`, `--silent` | Suppress output and missing-command diagnostics. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

- Shell aliases, functions and builtins are not searched.

Build from source with the MoonBit 1.0 RC1 toolchain.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
